items.title: Tenuo – Capability-Based Authorization (Macaroons for AI Agents)
items.raw_excerpt: I've been working on a different authorization model for AI agents, motivated by a simple problem: once agents start delegating work to other agents, identity-based permissions and prompt guardrails break down fast. Tenuo makes authority task-scoped. A manager agent starts with a signed capability ("warrant") and can delegate to workers, but delegation can only attenuate. Each step gets narrower authority, and it disappears when the task ends. Even if an agent is prompt-injected, it can't take actions outside its warrant. Every tool call requires proof-of-possession, and arguments are validated against explicit constraints before execution. This is inspired by systems like Macaroons / Biscuit / UCAN, but adapted for AI agents processing untrusted input: - signed, ephemeral capability token

items.raw_excerpt: 在大语言模型逐步从通用推理工具走向专业领域应用的过程中，运筹优化（OR）成为一个极具吸引力、同时也极具挑战性的方向。 一方面，运筹优化问题天然具备清晰的数学结构和可验证的求解结果，看似非常适合由模型自动完成建模与求解；另一方面，真实运筹建模高度依赖变量定义、约束设计与目标函数之间的整体一致性，其推理过程往往呈现出强步骤依赖和强耦合特征，远非算出一个正确答案所能覆盖。 正是在这一张力之下，当前运筹建模大模型研究逐渐暴露出一个核心困境：模型在求解器层面得到正确结果，并不意味着其完成了正确的建模。在现有主流训练范式中，无论是仅依据最终求解结果进行奖励，还是对中间步骤进行局部、逐步的过程监督，都难以准确刻画运筹建模这种长链条推理任务的真实质量。 这种监督信号与任务本质之间的错位，使得建模错误可能被掩盖，甚至被反复强化，逐渐成为大模型走向工业级运筹优化应用的关键瓶颈。在这样的研究背景下，来自上海交通大学智能计算研究院葛冬冬、林江浩研究团队提出了《StepORLM: A Self-Evolving Framework with Generative Process Supervision for Operations Research Language Models》。 这项研究并未仅从模型规模或数据量入手，而是从训练范式本身出发，系统性反思了结果奖励与传统过程监督在运筹建模任务中的根本局限，并提出了一种由策略模型与生成式过程奖励模型（GenPRM）协同进化的自进化训练框架。通过将最终求解结果与对完整推理过程的回顾式、全局评估相结合，StepORLM 试图引导模型真正学习如何构建一致、可靠的运筹优化模型，而不仅仅是生成一个可行解。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22558 小模型，赢在方法 在实验评估方面，这项研究在 6 个具有代表性的运筹优化基准数据

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在大语言模型逐步从通用推理工具走向专业领域应用的过程中，运筹优化（OR）成为一个极具吸引力、同时也极具挑战性的方向。 一方面，运筹优化问题天然具备清晰的数学结构和可验证的求解结果，看似非常适合由模型自动完成建模与求解；另一方面，真实运筹建模高度依赖变量定义、约束设计与目标函数之间的整体一致性，其推理过程往往呈现出强步骤依赖和强耦合特征，远非算出一个正确答案所能覆盖。 正是在这一张力之下，当前运筹建模大模型研究逐渐暴露出一个核心困境：模型在求解器层面得到正确结果，并不意味着其完成了正确的建模。在现有主流训练范式中，无论是仅依据最终求解结果进行奖励，还是对中间步骤进行局部、逐步的过程监督，都难以准确刻画运筹建模这种长链条推理任务的真实质量。 这种监督信号与任务本质之间的错位，使得建模错误可能被掩盖，甚至被反复强化，逐渐成为大模型走向工业级运筹优化应用的关键瓶颈。在这样的研究背景下，来自上海交通大学智能计算研究院葛冬冬、林江浩研究团队提出了《StepORLM: A Self-Evolving Framework with Generative Process Supervision for Operations Research Language Models》。 这项研究并未仅从模型规模或数据量入手，而是从训练范式本身出发，系统性反思了结果奖励与传统过程监督在运筹建模任务中的根本局限，并提出了一种由策略模型与生成式过程奖励模型（GenPRM）协同进化的自进化训练框架。通过将最终求解结果与对完整推理过程的回顾式、全局评估相结合，StepORLM 试图引导模型真正学习如何构建一致、可靠的运筹优化模型，而不仅仅是生成一个可行解。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22558 小模型，赢在方法 在实验评估方面，这项研究在 6 个具有代表性的运筹优化基准数据
excerpt_i18n.en: As large language models gradually transition from general-purpose reasoning tools to applications in specialized domains, operations research (OR) has emerged as a highly attractive yet challenging direction. On one hand, OR problems inherently possess clear mathematical structures and verifiable solutions, making them seemingly well-suited for automated modeling and solving by models. On the other hand, real-world OR modeling heavily relies on the overall consistency among variable definitions, constraint design, and objective functions, with reasoning processes often characterized by strong step dependency and high coupling, far beyond merely computing a correct answer. It is precisely under this tension that current research on large-scale OR modeling has revealed a core dilemma: a model obtaining correct results at the solver level does not necessarily mean it has performed correct modeling. Under existing mainstream training paradigms, whether rewarding based solely on final results or providing localized, step-by-step process supervision, it remains difficult to accurately capture the true quality of long-chain reasoning tasks like OR modeling. This misalignment between supervision signals and the task’s essence allows modeling errors to be concealed or even repeatedly reinforced, gradually becoming a key bottleneck for large models advancing toward industrial-level OR applications. excerpt_i18n.en:
In 2026, the artificial intelligence industry stands at a critical crossroads. On one hand, the "Scaling Law" dividends of general large models are nearing their peak, with capital heavily focused on world models. On the other hand, the fragmentation and non-standardization of industrial scenarios pose significant challenges for AI implementation. Against this backdrop, a seminar themed "Breaking Through with Applications, Uniting Ecosystems" was quietly held in Beijing, featuring the industrial internet company Wanlian Yida and its comprehensive industrial AI large model, "Wanlian Moore."  

At the event, the "Industrial Artificial Intelligence Research and Application Expert Committee" was officially inaugurated, led by Sun Maosong, Executive Vice Dean of the Institute for Artificial Intelligence at Tsinghua University and a Foreign Fellow of the European Academy of Sciences. The committee brings together AI research expertise from top universities such as Harbin Institute of Technology, the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing Institute of Technology, and Northeastern University, signaling a joint effort to advance the future development and application of Wanlian Moore.  

Sun Maosong serves as the chief consultant of the Industrial Artificial Intelligence Research and Application Expert Committee.  

The next phase of "AI + Industry" is no longer about isolated technological breakthroughs but focuses on industrial applications, addressing the structural mismatch between fragmented scenarios and systemic capabilities.  

In the past, vertical large models were rapidly deployed in fields such as finance, healthcare, and agriculture, but most remained at the "question-and-answer assistant" stage, falling far short of the ideal "AI productivity expectations." Real-world industrial decisions often lack clear problem boundaries. For example, "How to expand the Inner Mongolia lamb trade to Xuzhou, where demand is high?" involves multidimensional variables such as supply chains, local dietary culture, and brand influence.

En este contexto, se celebró discretamente en Beijing un seminario bajo el lema "Romper barreras con aplicaciones, unir fuerzas en el ecosistema", protagonizado por la empresa de internet industrial Wanlian Yida y su modelo de IA de gran escala para toda la industria, "Wanlian Moore". excerpt_i18n.en:
On February 2, Ant Group's general AI assistant Lingguang announced a comprehensive upgrade to its core feature "Flash Apps," officially launching two new capabilities: "Upload Image to Generate App" and "Desktop Widgets." The upgrade integrates nearly 20 API tools, including sound synthesis, large language model (LLM) calls, calendar services, multimodal understanding, text-to-speech, persistent storage, gyroscope, and vibration feedback. After the upgrade, users can not only efficiently create personalized mini-tools, but the generated apps also offer real-time feedback and immersive audiovisual-tactile interactive experiences, significantly enhancing both practicality and fun.  

With the "Upload Image to Generate App" feature, the system intelligently analyzes image content to replicate UI interfaces, extract key information in a structured format, and recognize scene styles. Combined with personalized instructions, it transforms static images into dynamic, interactive tools with a single click. For example, users can upload images such as student grade sheets or product sales charts to generate online management tools for data visualization and collaboration. This "what you see is what you get" image-to-app model improves efficiency in work and daily life scenarios. The seamless integration of image recognition and app generation may become a key direction for lightweight app development.  

The newly integrated nearly 20 API tools support diverse scenarios such as life planning, education and learning, and creative interaction, helping users build more feature-rich applications.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 2 de febrero, el asistente de IA general Lingguang de Ant anunció una actualización integral de su función principal "Flash Apps", lanzando oficialmente dos nuevas capacidades: "Crear Apps Subiendo Imágenes" y "Widgets de Escritorio", e integrando cerca de 20 herramientas API, incluyendo síntesis de efectos de sonido, llamadas a modelos de lenguaje grande (LLM), servicios de calendario, comprensión multimodal, lectura de texto en voz alta, almacenamiento persistente, giroscopio y retroalimentación háptica. Tras la actualización, los usuarios no solo pueden crear herramientas personalizadas de manera eficiente, sino que las aplicaciones generadas también ofrecen retroalimentación en tiempo real y una experiencia interactiva inmersiva audiovisual y táctil, mejorando simultáneamente la utilidad y el entretenimiento. items.title: 万联易达成立产业人工智能研究与应用专家委员会，实现产研双向奔赴
items.raw_excerpt: 当AI从技术概念迈入价值兑现的“深水区”，产研如何深度携手，通力共现产业AI化、技术商业化的价值闭环？ 产业级AI大模型研发过程中存在哪些技术卡点亟待解决？ 前沿AI应用如何穿透复杂的产业链条，真正融入产业决策环境？ ...... 1月30日，万联易达作为推进产业AI大模型在全产业应用落地的领先企业，在京举办“以应用破局·以生态聚力”为主题的“AI+产业发展”专题研讨会。会上，全国首个“产业人工智能研究与应用专家委员会”（下称“专委会”）正式揭牌。 清华大学人工智能研究院常务副院长、欧洲科学院外籍院士孙茂松作为专委会首席顾问，领衔哈尔滨工业大学刘铭教授、中国科学院大学徐俊刚教授、北京理工大学张磊教授、东北大学刘正皓副教授等人工智能技术顾问，共同推动产业AI大模型“万联摩尔”的构建、研发和应用工作，为其下一步发展注入智力支持。 与会嘉宾表示，此次研讨并非单纯的技术展演，而是直面产研断链痛点，基于万联摩尔的全产业AI超级载体定位的路径分析，来构建“AI+数据+场景”铁三角，引领产业智能化迈入全新周期。 万联易达特设“顾问直通车” 随着国家发改委等八部委联合印发《“人工智能+制造”专项行动实施意见》，人工智能被首次明确定位为支撑现代化产业体系的“社会基础设施”。 政策红利持续释放，但AI+产业发展的深层矛盾却日益凸显，“AI研究已经走到了‘世界模型’阶段，但场景应用落地却还处于‘涌现窗口期’。”孙茂松教授在主旨演讲《人工智能和大模型：发展态势及其产业应用》中精准指出这一现状。 清华大学人工智能研究院常务副院长、欧洲科学院外籍院士 孙茂松 在孙茂松教授看来，文本、代码类模型已走到Scaling Law递减阶段，智能涌现随时可能出现；部分专用模型也在训练范式、结构化推理等关键技术上取得突破性进展，“当前正是技术原型与商业应用双向赋能的好时候。”AI在产业落地已经在内外部具备了一定优势

excerpt_i18n.en: As AI transitions from a technological concept into the "deep-water zone" of value realization, how can industry and research collaborate deeply to jointly realize the value loop of industrial AI adoption and technological commercialization? What technical bottlenecks in the development of industrial-scale AI models urgently need to be addressed? How can cutting-edge AI applications penetrate complex industrial chains and truly integrate into industrial decision-making environments? On January 30, Wanlian Yida, as a leading enterprise promoting the application and implementation of industrial AI models across industries, held a thematic seminar titled "AI + Industrial Development" with the theme "Breaking Through with Applications, Gathering Strength with Ecosystems" in Beijing. At the event, the nation’s first "Industrial Artificial Intelligence Research and Application Expert Committee" (referred to as the "Expert Committee") was officially inaugurated. Sun Maosong, Executive Vice Dean of the Institute for Artificial Intelligence at Tsinghua University and a Foreign Fellow of the European Academy of Sciences, serves as the chief advisor of the Expert Committee. Leading a team of AI technical advisors, including Professor Liu Ming from Harbin Institute of Technology, Professor Xu Jungang from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Professor Zhang Lei from Beijing Institute of Technology, and Associate Professor Liu Zhenghao from Northeastern University, they jointly advance the construction, development, and application of the industrial AI model "Wanlian Moore," injecting intellectual support into its next phase of development. Attendees noted that this seminar was not merely a technical showcase but directly addressed the pain points of disconnection between industry and research. Based on the positioning of Wanlian Moore as a comprehensive industrial AI super-carrier, the event analyzed pathways to build the "AI + Data + Scenarios" triad, guiding industrial intelligence into a new cycle. Wanlian Yida has specially established an "Advisor Direct Channel." Following the joint release of the "Action Plan for 'AI + Manufacturing'" by eight ministries, including the National Development and Reform Commission...
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando la IA pasa de ser un concepto tecnológico a adentrarse en la "zona profunda" de la materialización de valor, ¿cómo pueden colaborar estrechamente la producción y la investigación para lograr conjuntamente el ciclo cerrado de valor de la transformación industrial mediante IA y la comercialización tecnológica? ¿Qué cuellos de botella técnicos deben resolverse urgentemente en el desarrollo de modelos de IA a nivel industrial? ¿Cómo pueden las aplicaciones de IA de vanguardia penetrar en las complejas cadenas industriales e integrarse realmente en el entorno de toma de decisiones del sector? ... El 30 de enero, Wanlian Yida, como empresa líder en promover la aplicación de modelos de IA industrial en toda la industria, celebró en Beijing un seminario temático sobre "IA + desarrollo industrial" con el tema "Romper barreras con aplicaciones, unir fuerzas con ecosistemas". En el evento, se estableció el primer "Comité de Expertos en Investigación y Aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial Industrial" del país (en adelante, "Comité de Expertos").

excerpt_i18n.en: On February 1, the Medical Artificial Intelligence Collaborative Innovation Forum and the first 2026 academic conference of the Medical Artificial Intelligence Alliance (in preparation) were held at Huawei's Lianqiu Lake Shanghai R&D Center. During the event, Huawei Cloud launched the "Smart Healthcare" zone under its "Industry AI Dream Factory," encompassing essential technologies and resources for advancing "AI + healthcare." These include collaborating with Ruijin Hospital to introduce the industry's first smart pathology end-cloud collaborative solution, partnering with iKang Group to create a health management intelligent agent, and establishing the nation's first medical AI community tailored for the healthcare sector. This initiative indicates Huawei Cloud's strategic focus on the "AI + healthcare" domain, reflecting how the explosion of large model technology is accelerating the integration of artificial intelligence into deeper industrial applications. The Smart Healthcare zone is the first vertical industry zone implemented under Huawei Cloud's "Industry AI Dream Factory." It deeply integrates the clinical expertise of top-tier medical institutions with Huawei's core technological strengths in ICT, cloud, and AI. Targeting diverse groups such as grassroots hospitals, doctors, patients, industry partners, and developers, it builds an end-to-end medical AI support system covering "scenarios, models, platforms, and communities." According to Leiphone, for grassroots hospitals and doctors, Huawei Cloud released the industry's first smart pathology cloud-edge-end solution. Through cloud-edge-end collaboration, the capabilities of the RuiPath pathology large model, jointly developed by Ruijin Hospital and Huawei, are delivered to grassroots levels via cloud services or smart pathology all-in-one machines. This transforms cutting-edge capabilities from leading hospitals into accessible and affordable tools for grassroots hospitals.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 1 de febrero, se celebró en el Centro de Investigación y Desarrollo de Huawei en el Lago Lianqiu de Shanghái el Foro de Innovación Colaborativa de Inteligencia Artificial Médica y la primera reunión académica de 2026 de la Alianza de Inteligencia Artificial Médica (en preparación). Durante el evento, Huawei Cloud lanzó la zona especializada de "Fábrica de Sueños de IA Industrial" para atención médica inteligente, que abarca tecnologías y recursos esenciales para el desarrollo de "IA + medicina", como la solución pionera de colaboración entre dispositivos y la nube para patología inteligente desarrollada conjuntamente con el Hospital Ruijin, el agente inteligente de gestión de salud creado en colaboración con el Grupo iKang, y la primera comunidad de IA médica en China dirigida al sector sanitario. Esta iniciativa muestra que Huawei Cloud ha comenzado a enfocarse en el campo de "IA + medicina", reflejando también cómo la explosión tecnológica de los modelos grandes está acelerando la integración humana.

excerpt_i18n.en: The concept of AI in healthcare has been a buzzword in the industry for nearly a decade, yet three formidable gaps persist between laboratory algorithm models and clinical hospital applications: the conflict between data security and utilization, the mismatch between technical barriers and clinical needs, and communication hurdles in cross-disciplinary collaboration. Many well-resourced hospitals have invested heavily in AI systems, only to see them become mere "window displays," while primary care institutions eager for technological empowerment are held back by insufficient operational capabilities and prohibitively high adaptation costs. Amid widespread industry uncertainty where acclaim fails to translate into practical adoption, Inspur Information has provided a replicable solution in Foshan's Nanhai District through a battle-tested "production-research-application" closed-loop model. On January 22, 2026, at the Foshan Nanhai District "Artificial Intelligence + Healthcare" Ecosystem Co-construction Seminar, the district’s "AI + Healthcare" ecosystem co-construction framework was officially unveiled. Simultaneously, the "AI-Native Smart Healthcare System"—jointly developed over two years by Inspur Information, Tianrui Yijian, and Foshan Nanhai District People’s Hospital—was introduced as a practical example of "AI + Healthcare." Rather than chasing conceptual hype, it focuses on real pain points across the entire diagnosis and treatment process. Through a collaborative "production-research-application" mechanism where "hospitals define needs, enterprises adapt solutions, and platforms provide robust support," AI technology is genuinely embedded in clinical frontline settings and extended to grassroots levels. Framework Launch: The "One Body, Two Wings, Three Drives" Mechanism Born from Practice. Currently, artificial intelligence has become a core pillar in healthcare for "strengthening primary care, consolidating foundations, and ensuring essential services."
excerpt_i18n.es: El concepto de la IA médica ha resonado en la industria durante casi una década, pero entre los modelos algorítmicos de laboratorio y la aplicación clínica en hospitales siempre han existido tres brechas difíciles de superar: la contradicción entre la seguridad y el uso de los datos, la desconexión entre el umbral tecnológico y las necesidades clínicas, y las barreras de comunicación en la colaboración interdisciplinaria. Muchos hospitales con recursos han invertido grandes sumas en introducir sistemas de IA, que finalmente terminan como "exhibiciones de escaparate"; las instituciones médicas de base anhelan el empoderamiento tecnológico, pero se detienen ante la insuficiencia de capacidad de mantenimiento y los altos costos de adaptación. En un momento de confusión generalizada en la industria, donde hay más elogios que resultados prácticos, Inspur Information ha ofrecido en Foshan Nanhai una respuesta replicable para romper el estancamiento, mediante un modelo de ciclo cerrado "investigación-producción-aplicación" probado en la práctica.
